newsitem.title: UK: SWIMMING-WORLD BEST FOR HAN, EUROPEAN RECORD FOR HICKMAN.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-WORLD BEST FOR HAN, EUROPEAN RECORD FOR HICKMAN.

text.p: China's Han Xue improved her own world best time for the women's short-course 50 metres breaststroke at a World Cup swimming meeting on Wednesday.
Han, 15, sliced 0.10 seconds from the mark she set in Beijing on January 11, 1996, winning her race in 30.88 seconds.
She seized control from the dive, racing through the first 25 metres of the Tollcross Park pool in 14.30, more than half a second clear of nearest challenger Tara Sloan of Canada.
Han won by more than a second from Britain's Jaime King and Sloan.
Britain's James Hickman broke the European short-course record for the men's 100 metres butterfly.

Hickman clocked 52.34 seconds to beat the mark of 52.51 set by Germany's Michael Gross in Aachen on March 10, 1990, and equalled by Denis Silantiev of Ukraine in Espoo, Finland on January 23 this year.
Hickman finished second behind Australia's Michael Klim, who won in 52.09, just 0.02 seconds outside the world record of Canada's Marcel Gery. R
